set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KXZZZWCEEDVD963AZA40FHE7

Objective:
Independently decide whether the CCA vertical slice is scientifically correct and actually demonstrates composition rather than hiding a new engine.

Required evidence:
- Analytic one-dimensional and zero/perfect-effect cases.
- Differential agreement among explicit dense projectors, streamed sufficient statistics, and committed fmrireg.cca fixtures.
- Metamorphic row/run/feature permutations, contrast and nuisance basis changes, orthogonal feature rotations, scale laws, sign handling, and repeated-root subspace checks.
- Leakage sentinels for held-out labels, responses, whitening, regularization, feature preparation, and orientation.
- Null calibration and held-out signal-recovery simulations that are independent of implementation equality tests.
- Memory/allocation evidence that no whole-analysis beta table or time-by-time projector is required.
- JVM and Scala.js focused suites followed by compileAll and testAll.
- Module and import audit proving generic spectral work remains in Gale and ordinary paired CCA has not forked.
- Reader-facing documentation that distinguishes canonical effect detection from directed classification and lists version-one non-goals.

Acceptance:
All evidence is attached to one committed revision; failures are typed and reproducible; no unsupported statistical claim is hidden by a green internal test; and the parent epic can close without spatial-channel, full-MANOVA, RSA, or probabilistic extensions.
set.title: CCA 4: independent parity, leakage, portability, and architecture gate
